name: gamesku-store-backend-security-check
description: Pemeriksaan otomatis keamanan backend PHP gamesku.store

scripts.audit: echo 'Composer audit: tidak diterapkan (backend murni PHP, tanpa dependensi 3rd party)'
scripts.lint: echo 'PHP lint: gunakan php -l per file; contoh: for f in src/*.php src/Pengendali/*.php api/index.php; do php -l "$f" || exit 1; done'
scripts.check: echo 'SECURITY CHECKLIST' && echo '1. SQL Injection: https://github.com/maizarsec1337/gamesku/security' && echo '2. Auth/Session: VERIFY session_regenerate_id + CSRF Token' && echo '3. Access Control: VERIFY Auth::wajib() on all sensitive endpoints' && echo '4. Input Validation: VERIFY all input via $this->teks()/$this->angka()' && echo '5. Error Handling: VERIFY display_errors=0 in production' && echo '6. CORS: VERIFY cors_origins matches actual frontend origins' && echo '7. Secrets: VERIFY config/config.php is not in git' && echo '8. File Upload: VERIFY mime_content_type + extension whitelist' && echo '9. Rate Limiting: VERIFY AuthRateLimiter on /api/auth/masuk' && echo '10. Logging: VERIFY no password/token in logs'
scripts.test: echo 'Integration tests: run manually after server is deployed' && echo '  - curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/auth/masuk -d ...'
scripts.pre-commit: echo 'Run: npm run lint && npm run check'
scripts.deploy: echo 'Deploy backend PHP to server; build frontend separately to Vercel' && echo 'Do NOT put PHP source or DB credentials in Vercel environment variables' && echo 'Frontend only needs API_BASE_URL'

author: gamesku.store
